mapper.select: select u.*, d.dept_name, r.role_code from sys_user u left join sys_department d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where u.username = #{username}

select u.*, d.dept_name, r.role_code from sys_user u left join sys_department d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id order by u.id desc

select u.*, d.dept_name, r.role_code from sys_user u left join sys_department d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where r.role_code = #{roleCode} order by u.id desc

mapper.insert: insert into sys_user(username, password, real_name, gender, phone, email, dept_id, position, status) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{deptId}, #{position}, #{status})
mapper.update: update sys_user set real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, dept_id = #{deptId}, position = #{position}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update sys_user set password = #{password} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_role(user_id, role_id) select #{userId}, id from sys_role where role_code = #{roleCode}
